title: Fastned: Tesla Model S Plaid 100 kWh / 100 kWh (2022+) charge curve
notes: Fastned vehicle page (Model S entries "Plaid 100 kWh" and "100 kWh (2022+)", charger class 300, CCS connector, listed max 218 kW). One kW value per whole SoC % (3-91 %) in the chart element data-json, read with curl. The two entries carry identical numbers. Fastned says curves assume a battery near 30 C; measured on its European CCS2 network, so the Tesla Supercharger V3 early plateau (about 250 kW) is capped at about 218 kW. Same reuse note as src-fastned-tesla-curves-2026: Fastned terms have no clause on chart data, robots allows; owner confirms. No Model X entry exists on the page.
